corrections.finding: Stronger than source: 'no brain' is not in the source (only no plan); 'whose flow is-not' makes slow-flow tubes zero-flow, source says slow-flow tubes thin and disappear; 'spreads out in each direction' adds detail; 'comes near' is weaker than the source's matching in cost, efficiency, fault tolerance; light also stands for obstacles and the mould avoids it, left out; explaining sentence ('a self aiming from each is-not to is') gives the mould an aim the source denies (no plan) and is unclear; 'shaped like' would be a dead participle, so the dish is given as an outline.
corrections.fixed_text: A slime mould, Physarum polycephalum, in a dish in the outline of Greater Tokyo, with oat flakes at the big cities and light where mountains, lakes and obstacles are, which it avoids, spreads out and then thins its branches until only tubes between food sources go on. The network it ends with closely resembles Tokyo's rail network and matches it in cost, in efficiency and in going on through a fault, with no plan. In the model, a tube with a fast flow widens, and a tube with a slow flow thins and disappears.

corrections.finding: Stronger than source: 'Caribbean' and 'a person' are not in the source (boat or lorry; Panulirus argus juveniles); 'walk toward home' fits only the north-northeast group, the west-southwest group oriented southwesterly; arena test and Faraday-cage test run together, so the 400 km fields read as part of the tethered trial; 'A field calls it' is unclear and unattributed; 'the first shown' is a dead participle; 'still-possibling' is unclear; explaining sentence (lobster finds the field is-not home's and aims from it, no store of a route) states a mechanism when the source says the map's nature is unrevealed.
corrections.fixed_text: Young spiny lobsters, Panulirus argus, go by boat or lorry along a winding route with no useful chemical, visual or magnetic cue on the way, some boxes with swinging magnets, then on a tether in a round arena with their eyestalks under a cover: those from north-northeast of home orient homeward, those from west-southwest orient southwest. In a Faraday cage, the field of a place some 400 km north of home sends them walking south-southwest, and the field of a place some 400 km south sends them walking about north. This is the first demonstration of true navigation in an invertebrate, and what the map is stays open.

corrections.finding: Stronger than source or unclear: 'let go' is a dead participle; 'come home about as well' narrows the source's navigated about as well; 'smell dimming' is unclear (anosmic means no smell) and 'dramatically lost' replaces the source's dramatically impaired in orientation and homing; 'no landmark' is not in the source; explaining sentence (a sea's air is an orienting surface, each self orienting by its own) says far more than the observing supports.
corrections.fixed_text: On release at open ocean some 800 km from their colony, Cory's shearwaters of the Azores with a magnetic disturbance navigate about as well as birds with none; birds that lack smell are dramatically impaired in orientation and homing: some wander long, some reach home by chance or by sight, some do not come home. Smell counts on this trip; the magnetic disturbance does not.

corrections.finding: Stronger than source: 'each godwit a tracker follows' narrows and changes the source's all birds; explaining sentence says departing is a sequencing with wind and is-not a clock's timing, but the source only says all birds took off with favourable winds, not why or how they chose the time; 'going its way' is unclear; 'no stopping' fine, 'a tracker names E7' unclear.
corrections.fixed_text: A bar-tailed godwit, E7, flies 11,680 km nonstop from Alaska to New Zealand in more than eight days, with no food and no water; all the birds set out with favourable winds. Wind and bird go the same way at take-off.

corrections.finding: Stronger than source: 'a roost' is not in the source (nearby obstacles, exit); the model's assumption that bats tell their own echoes from others is left out; 'No one call is whole; a sequence of calls is' overstates, since ten calls give about 87 in 100, not all; 'a co-sequencing in place of a perfect signal' is unclear; 'about 20 times in 100' is fine but 'at each call' and 'go on better' are loose.
corrections.fixed_text: In a model by Mazar and Yovel, bats leave together: with 100 bats about half of a bat's echoes from a wall a metre off go missing in the others' calls, and a bat still goes on by gathering echoes across calls; at 40 bats about 20 in 100 get out with one call's echoes and about 87 in 100 with ten. The model has each bat tell its own echoes from the others, and leaves out a bat hearing the others' echoes and following its neighbours; its authors expect real bats to do better. One call gets few out; ten calls get most out.
